-- Remove the index that does not match the query.
DROP INDEX orders_status_idx;

-- Equality columns first, then the column that supplies the order.
CREATE INDEX orders_customer_status_placed_idx
    ON orders (customer_id, status, placed_at DESC)
    INCLUDE (id, total_cents);

-- Verify the plan with EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS); look for an index scan.
EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS)
SELECT id, placed_at, total_cents
FROM orders
WHERE customer_id = 'c1'
  AND status = 'paid'
ORDER BY placed_at DESC
LIMIT 20;
